items.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
items.snippet: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K
items.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.8 million in net outflows Friday, led by ARK 21Shares, as total fund assets slipped back below $100 billion.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million. Most avoided exchanges
items.snippet: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.
